findings.issue_text: [High/bug] pkg/expr/reader.go:194-200 — `enableSqlExpressions` always returns `false`: the flag check is inverted (`enabled := !h.features.IsEnabledGlobally(featuremgmt.FlagSqlExpressions)`) and both the `if enabled` branch and the fall-through return `false`, so the `sqlExpressions` feature flag can never enable the feature and every `QueryTypeSQL` query is rejected at pkg/expr/reader.go:129-132 regardless of flag state; it should simply be `return h.features.IsEnabledGlobally(featuremgmt.FlagSqlExpressions)`.

[High/bug] pkg/expr/sql/db.go:12-22 — All `DB` methods are permanent `errors.New("not implemented")` stubs, so `SQLCommand.Execute` (pkg/expr/sql_command.go:95-99) and `TablesList` (pkg/expr/sql/parser.go:23) always fail; this silently replaces the working go-duck/DuckDB implementation (removed from go.mod in this same PR) with non-functional plumbing, so any deployment enabling `sqlExpressions` gets runtime "not implemented" errors instead of query results. If the dependency must be dropped, the SQL-expression code path should be removed or fail fast at construction, not left as executable-but-broken.

[Medium/test_gap] pkg/expr — The PR changes parsing and execution behavior (new hard-failure gate in reader.go, stubbed DB) but includes no test additions or updates; a unit test asserting that `QueryTypeSQL` parses when `sqlExpressions` is enabled would have caught the always-false bug in `enableSqlExpressions`, and existing tests exercising `TablesList`, `SQLCommand.Execute`, or SQL expression parsing against the real DuckDB will now fail with "not implemented".

[Low/doc_defect] pkg/expr/reader.go:131 — The rejection error `sqlExpressions is not implemented` misdescribes the condition: the query is refused because the feature flag is disabled, not because parsing is unimplemented, and it gives operators no indication that the `sqlExpressions` toggle exists or controls this behavior.

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces broken behavior: `enableSqlExpressions` in `pkg/expr/reader.go` always returns `false` (it returns `false` in both branches), so `QueryTypeSQL` now hard-fails with `fmt.Errorf("sqlExpressions is not implemented")` for all SQL queries. Additionally, the PR replaces the real DuckDB dependency with a new `pkg/expr/sql/db.go` stub where `RunCommands`/`QueryFramesInto`/`TablesList` are all effectively non-functional (`errors.New("not implemented")`), and `TablesList`/`SQLCommand.Execute` now call these stubs (`NewInMemoryDB()`), causing runtime failures. The finding’s point about missing tests is valid, but the diff itself clearly contains actual correctness defects.

adjudication.rationale: In pkg/expr/reader.go the SQL path is explicitly gated via enableSqlExpressions(h) and on a false result returns `fmt.Errorf("sqlExpressions is not implemented")`. From the diff, the refusal is tied to feature-flag logic (`h.features.IsEnabledGlobally(featuremgmt.FlagSqlExpressions)`), so the error text is misleading/underspecified because it doesn’t indicate the feature-flag toggle controls availability. (Notably, enableSqlExpressions currently always returns false, but the intent shown is still feature gating, not “unimplemented parsing”.)
